name: Keyboarding Practice (VLLA demo)
description: Students type a configurable passage and are auto-graded with a fixed formula that weights accuracy at 65% and WPM at 35% (WPM scored against a 30 wpm target, capped), with an additional accuracy multiplier. The passage and title can be customized per zest via the Assessment Editor. This copy adds a preview mode for people who open it without a Canvas launch (for example from a QR code at a conference); its name differs from the production package so uploading it never updates production copies.
